# ajigu — TUTU

> TUTU is an iPhone AI photo eraser by ajigu. Tap any object in a photo—people, wires, trash cans—and on-device AI removes it and rebuilds the scene, privately. Nothing leaves the device.

## App

- [TUTU](https://tutu.ajigu.com/): iPhone AI photo eraser. Tap-to-erase with automatic object outlines, brush/line/box tools for manual areas, auto-remove, tunable detection sensitivity, full-quality export to the photo library. Detection and inpainting run entirely on device—no account, no uploads, no tracking. Free download and editing trial. Saving edited photos requires TUTU Premium (monthly, annual, or lifetime).
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tutu-ai-object-remover/id6480340301?uo=4

## Policy

AI crawlers are welcome. Content may be quoted with attribution to tutu.ajigu.com.
